Peripheral Drivers

v1.2.0

  • Added

    • Add a limit protection for the count value of API ENHTIM_SetMaxCount().(I279da4f)

    • Add API I2C_WaitForFIFO, Add API I2C_WaitTXIdle.(643b6d0f)

    • Add API AON_QDEC_DeInit(). (94e434de)

    • Add enable parameter in CANRxFrame_TypeDef. (682dc6fa)

  • Changed

    • Remove edl bit in can driver.(682dc6fa)

    • Delete member I2S_Scheme and I2S_BClockFixEn in API I2S_StructInit.(43c7eb0d)

    • Update i2c driver.(643b6d0f)

      • Modify i2c clock speed calculate to fit more clk scr div.

      • Modify spike time settings.(For FS & FS_PLUS mode, max 50ns).

      • Optimize the implementation of master wirte/read/repeat read API.

      • Optimize the implementation of I2C set clock speed.

      • Modify timeout to 0xFFF.

    • Modify keyscan debounce settings to 9-bit of KeyScan_debounceConfig().(fc3383c3)

    • Modify adc lib path

    • Modify can lib compile warning

  • Fixed

    • Declear driver lib func to fix CI warning.(1d9fc413)

    • Fix pending clear operation in init.(7b7cd886)

    • Fix warning in ethernet module.(bada4647)

v1.1.0

  • Added

    • Improve the API Reference for all driver.(ff27517b, a197e469)

      • Add default initialization values for the structure in API XXX_StructInit.

      • Add corresponding explanations for each enumeration variable value.

  • Changed

    • Rename IMDC to IDU.(91b411fd)

  • Fixed

    • Fix SPI3W DLPS exit function and typedef error.(d5b88d46, c94e73ec5)

v1.0.0.1

  • Added

    • Add CAN I2C IR SPI ENHTIM UART get clock function.(555e9bbe)

      • Add API CAN_ClkGet(), I2C_ClkGet(), IR_ClkGet(), SPI_ClkGet(), ENHTIM_ClkGet(), TIM_ClkGet(), UART_ClkGet().

      • Add I2C_Clock_Divider and UART_Clock_Divider enum.

    • Add PPE support scale cover function.(adea136d)

      • Add API PPE_Scale_Rect_Cover.

    • Add rtl87x2g_can.lib and librtl87x2g.a.(fd1c7929)

  • Fixed

    • Fix abnormal data in tx fifo during UART initialization.(0596138d)

v1.0.0

  • Added

    • Add I2C I2C_INT_MST_ON_HOLD interrupt bit and some flags.(01068ea7)

    • Add SPI0 high speed function SPI0_HS.(9bdca02f)

    • Add SPI3W enter/exit dlps function.(3f7e7a15)

  • Changed

    • Modify CAN init struct member.(f9c2e5a9, 6d34ac7d)

      • Add member CAN_FdSspAutoEn in CAN_InitTypeDef.

      • Modify CAN_TEST_MODE_LOOP_BACK to CAN_TEST_MODE_LOOPBACK.

      • Remove settings CAN_FdSspCal.b.can_fd_ssp_auto.

    • Modify IR clock typedef, Add IR_CLOCK_90M and IR_CLOCK_100M enum.(f9929cef, eae58e00)

    • Modify SPI Init Struct defines and some functions: (3e17a6e9)

      • Remove SPI swap function.

      • Change SPI_NDF to SPI_RXNDF.(both struct member can use)

    • Modify UART baud rate typedef.(8d569957)

      • Add UART_BAUD_RATE_4800 and UART_BAUD_RATE_7200, remove UART_BAUD_RATE_6000000.

    • Move the clock setting API from RCC driver to each IP itself. At the same time, the naming of APIs has been changed.(1e5f39b9)

      • RCC_ENHTIMClkConfig is renamed as ENHTIM_ClkConfig().

      • RCC_I2CClkDivConfig is renamed as I2C_ClkDivConfig().

      • RCC_IRClkConfig is renamed as IR_ClkConfig().

      • RCC_SPIClkDivConfig is renamed as SPI_ClkDivConfig().

      • RCC_SPIClkConfig is renamed as SPI_ClkConfig().

      • RCC_TIMClkConfig is renamed as TIM_ClkConfig().

      • RCC_UARTClkDivConfig is renamed as UART_ClkDivConfig().

  • Fixed

    • Fix ADC Hardware average issue.(33bea73b)

    • Fix API Pad_SetDrivingCurrent() bug.(560302f8)

    • Fix CODEC micbias bug.(4e1f99c2, dd0e772d)

    • Fix DMA disable multi block fail error.(bfc4c8be)

    • Fix LPC config threshold error.(5fef0179)

    • Fix SPI3W read data error.(983fda07)

    • Modify ADC/CODEC power on flow for force vddcore 1v2.(977a9291)

    • Modify ADC/CODEC/LPC power off flow to avoid conflict.(8bdc1989, 95061329)

    • Modify core qdec init flow.(a557a35c)

    • Modify IMDC API IMDC_Decode to fix an error causing IMDC fail to decode file greater than 256KB.(ed62476f)

    • Remove DEB_CNT_EN disable when disable gpio debounce.(e3056c48)

    • Update I2C set clock speed calculate.(5b0a3c0c)

Removed

  • Remove ADC init struct member ADC_PowAD1Dly/ADC_PowAD2Dly/ADC_PowRefDly.(95dc9be8)
